metadata.title: On Lu's second gap conjecture in higher codimension
metadata.abstract: Let $M^n\to\Sph^{n+q}(1)$, $n\ge3$ and $q\ge2$, be a closed minimal immersion. Set $S=|h|^2$ and $Q=S+\lambda_2$, where $h$ is the second fundamental form and $\lambda_2$ is the second largest eigenvalue of Lu's fundamental matrix. We establish two complementary results concerning Lu's second-gap conjecture. First, for every $n\ge3$, we exhibit closed connected homogeneous minimal embeddings of $\Sph^1\times\Sph^{n-1}$ into $\Sph^{2n+1}(1)$ with constant $S$ and constant $Q$, whose $Q$-values are dense in $(n,2n)$. Totally geodesic inclusions yield the same density in every codimension $q\ge n+1$. Thus Lu's conjecture fails in these codimensions even under constant scalar curvature. Second, for every $n\ge3$, we prove that there exists $\gamma_n>0$, depending only on $n$, such that no closed connected minimal immersion into $\Sph^{n+2}(1)$ with constant $Q$ satisfies $n<Q<n+\gamma_n$. Hence Lu's second-gap conjecture holds in codimension two for all $n\ge3$.
metadata.comment: 23 pages. Comments and suggestions are welcome

analysis.progressType: 高余维反例与余维二间隙
analysis.workSummary: 对 n≥3 的闭极小浸入，研究 Lu 矩阵给出的 Q=S+第二特征值；构造 Q 值稠密于 (n,2n) 的齐性嵌入，从而否定余维至少 n+1 的第二间隙猜想，同时证明余维二具有正间隙。
analysis.breakthrough: 明确分离高余维反例与所有维度的余维二肯定结果。
analysis.limitations: 余维二结论要求 Q 恒定；未覆盖中间余维。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.priorityReason: 改变经典极小子流形间隙问题的余维图景。
